title: AgentDoc Lifecycle Mapping Contract
description: Versioned mapping between the flat `.adoc` authored status vocabularies and the six-dimension managed state (KNOWLEDGE-MODEL K4/K5). Consumed as data by the Cloud import path — never re-implemented. Mapping alone never establishes authority: applying a mapped target as state events requires a typed attestation (migration, source-control, or Cloud Governance Event); without one the target is advisory and governance stays proposed. Approval is never mapped to verification: mapping targets carry no verification member and no application lands any verification change — the dimension stays a gap until a verification run records an outcome. Versions resolve exact-match; an unknown recorded version is rejected with `schema.unsupported_version`.

mapping_version.description: The rule-set version this document carries. Recorded per application; historical replays resolve the contract for exactly the recorded version. Any rule change ships as a new version.

import_mapping.description: One entry per released Knowledge Object kind.

loss_declaration.description: Machine-readable per-dimension declaration of what the flat side cannot carry — one entry per K4 dimension, in K4 order.

projection.description: The versioned export projection: managed multi-dimension state to flat `.adoc` status. Lossy by nature; every application yields a projection output (see $defs/projectionOutput) whose loss report names every dropped dimension.

mappedManagedState.description: The multi-dimension target of one flat word. Deliberately has no verification member: no flat word can name a managed verification state.

statuses.description: Exact authored-word rules over the kind's released flat vocabulary.

unlisted_status.description: Open-vocabulary fallback (claim). Absent for closed vocabularies: an unlisted word fails closed with `schema.invalid_status`.

absent.description: The target when the kind authors no status.

carriage.description: none: no flat representation at all. partial: some distinctions carried, not all.

kindProjection.description: Ordered condition rules (first match wins) over an unconditional fallback, so projection is total. A rule rendering `verified` always requires recorded verification:verified — approval never renders as verification.

fallback.description: The word rendered when no rule matches (gaps included); null for kinds that author no status.

projectionOutput.description: One export projection application: the flat word (null for statusless kinds) plus the loss report naming every recorded dimension the word cannot carry back through this contract's import mapping.

connector.description: Present only for the per-connector synchronization dimension.

recovered.description: What re-importing the projected word recovers; null when the dimension has no flat carriage at all.
